finalDeployProcedure: Following evidence-only commit must pass its own Pages run,178-file hash audit and a fresh browser release smoke. Final SHA and deployment run are reported after completion.
limitations: One action per beat; not a real-time reflex action game or a large RPG.
Windows Chromium/Playwright native touch; Safari, Firefox, physical devices and screen readers not fully tested.
Automated detached-model combat evaluation is not human difficulty evaluation or a claim of optimal play.
Abstract door graph assumes each entered room can be cleared; combat survivability is checked separately by normal-resource routes.
